'''Hallion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The planet featured lava fields that produced [[Obsidian/Legends|obsidian]], and decorative spheres made of polished obsidian from the lava fields were prized for their dark luster. Hallion struggled during the transition from a private enterprise to adjust to the imperial economy of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire.]]
